synthesis.evidence_balance: mixed — growing absolute EBITDA and above-peer growth collide with a -78% forward-EPS collapse, worse-than-peer leverage, and negative forward FCF.

bull_points.claim: Absolute EBITDA has expanded sharply, not contracted — GAAP EBITDA rose to $56-63M in FY2025 from ~$29M in FY2024 even as the margin % optically stayed 8-16%, so the falling-margin read is a MISREAD of a genuinely growing profit base.
Revenue growth of 18% beats the peer-median 14% and EBITDA growth of 42% doubles the peer-median 21%, so on the fundamentals the name grows FASTER than the cohort it trades below.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ Comparable Analysis→Operating Statistics (name vs peer median: growth/margin/leverage/beta)

bull_points.claim: The name is FCF-positive and self-funding at ~$0.8M FY2025 FCF with net-debt/EBITDA ~2.8x, so it is not a liquidity-driven forced-seller situation.

The EV/EBITDA discount to peers (-25%) POSES a justified-vs-residual question the human must judge: with rev/EBITDA growth ABOVE peer median and margin AT peer median, the discount is not obviously earned on operating fundamentals — but the peer set is HETEROGENEOUS ($39M-$66.1B caps, 1682x span) so the median is not a clean benchmark.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ Comparable Analysis→Trading Multiples (name vs peer Median)

bull_points.claim: The forward multiple ladder collapses steeply — NTM TEV/EBITDA 12.8x falling to FY2028 9.1x and FY2030 6.2x on consensus growth — a genuine counter to the terminal read IF the estimates hold.
Sell-side posture remains constructive: 6 Buy / 2 Outperform / 0 Hold-or-worse with mean target $42 versus a $23.58 close, a genuine counter to the terminal read.

bear_points.claim: FY2026 EPS estimates have been gutted: GAAP EPS path fell -78% (0.45→0.10) and normalized EPS -49% (0.86→0.44) from 12m-ago to latest, a broad and deep downgrade of forward earnings power that is the REAL signal, not an optical artifact.

bear_points.claim: The trailing P/E of 91.4x is NOT a clean multiple — it rests on an anomalous trailing EPS of 0.21 versus a recent median of -0.54, so the headline 'cheap on EV/EBITDA' coexists with barely-positive GAAP earnings; the forward NTM P/E of 161.63x confirms depressed forward net income, not an optical distortion.

The forward EBITDA multiple ladder still steps down to single digits (FY2028 9.1x, FY2030 6.2x) on the same consensus, and the EBITDA guide range ($100-107M) was recently MET, implying the EPS collapse is concentrated below the EBITDA line (interest/tax/D&A) rather than in operating demand.

business_description.value: Artivion, Inc. manufactures, processes, and distributes medical devices and implantable human tissues worldwide. The company offers On-X prosthetic aortic and mitral heart valves; On-X ascending aortic prosthesis; CarbonAid CO2 diffusion catheters; Chord-X ePTFE sutures; pyrolytic carbon coating services; E-vita Open NEO, a hybrid stent graft; Arcevo, an LSA hybrid stent graft system; AMDS hybrid prosthesis; and NEXUS ONE, an endovascular stent graft system. It also provides NEXUS DUO, an aortic arch system; NEXUS TRE, a custom-made three branch graft; E-vita thoracic 3G, a stent graft system; E-xtra Design Engineering, a range of stent graft systems for the treatment of aortic vascular diseases, such as TAAA and Artivex; E-nside, a multibranch stent graft system; E-tegra, an AAA stent graft system; E-ventus BX and Tuva BX balloon-expandable peripheral stent grafts; and E-liac, a stent graft used to treat aneurysmal iliac arteries. In addition, the company offers synthetic vascular grafts that are used in open aortic and peripheral vascular surgical procedures; BioGlue, a surgical sealant; CryoValve SG pulmonary heart valve; CryoPatch SG pulmonary cardiac patch; SynerGraft, a decellularization technology; vascular preservation services; and PhotoFix, a bovine pericardial patch fixated. It markets its products and preservation services primarily to physicians through a direct sales team to hospitals and other healthcare facilities. The company was formerly known as CryoLife, Inc. and changed its name to Artivion, Inc. in January 2022. Artivion, Inc. was incorporated in 1984 and is headquartered in Kennesaw, Georgia.
